name: forms-connector
description: Create Google Forms, add questions, and read responses from Claude.
long_description: A local connector that lets Claude create and edit Google Forms and read their responses. It runs entirely on your computer. You sign in with your own Google OAuth client (bring your own client), and the sign-in token is stored only on this machine. Not affiliated with Google or Anthropic.

tools.name: get_form
tools.description: Fetch a form's questions, settings and item IDs

tools.name: add_question
tools.description: Add one question or section (with optional quiz grading)

tools.name: add_questions
tools.description: Add many questions and sections in one call

tools.name: update_question
tools.description: Edit an existing question or section

tools.name: update_form_info
tools.description: Change a form's title or description

tools.name: update_form_settings
tools.description: Turn quiz mode on or off

tools.name: set_accepting_responses
tools.description: Open or close a form to responses

tools.name: list_responses
tools.description: List responses with answers keyed by question text

client_id.title: Google OAuth Client ID
client_id.description: From your own Google Cloud project (OAuth client type: Desktop app). See the bring-your-own-client guide.

client_secret.title: Google OAuth Client Secret
client_secret.description: From the same OAuth client. Stored in your operating system's secure storage by Claude Desktop.
